title: Latest update
body:
Very disappointed with latest update. After updating Excel, the cell fill/color function I used regularly has disappeared from interface. I can no longer  easily  find or use the option to change the cell colors. The feature was essential to my work. Please bring it back or make it easily accessible again.

Correction: after 10 days the feature is back! Thank you✅

title: Bug with one cell selected

title: Why can’t you add a new line?
body: The app is mostly great, but I just can’t get over illogical limitations. Why isn’t it possible to add a new line inside a cell when writing text? Why isn’t it possible to simply insert and edit a hyperlink? Once this is fixed, I’d be willing to increase my rating, but now I need to turn on my laptop :)
